description: Issues related to drinking water supply, pipeline leaks, low pressure, and contaminated water.
examples: No water supply in our colony since yesterday morning.
Drinking water is coming dirty and smelling foul.
Main water pipeline is leaking heavily on Sector 4 road.

description: Power outages, frequent tripping, damaged electric poles, hanging wires, and meter faults.
examples: Frequent power cuts in our area without any prior notice.
High voltage wire is hanging loose dangerously near the park.
Electric transformer in our street made a loud bang and sparked.

description: Damaged asphalt roads, dangerous potholes, unpaved streets, and missing road dividers.
examples: Huge pothole on the hospital road causing frequent bike skids.
Road construction was left halfway and rubble is blocking traffic.
Main market road surface is completely broken and eroded.

description: Overflowing garbage bins, missed trash collection, illegal dumping, and uncleaned streets.
examples: Garbage collection truck has not visited our street for 4 days.
Waste dump near the community center is overflowing on the road.
Street sweepers are not cleaning the lane outside our apartment.

description: Blocked storm drains, overflowing sewer manholes, waterlogging during rain, and open gutters.
examples: Sewer line is overflowing and dirty sewage water is on the street.
Storm water drain is choked with plastic waste causing stagnation.
Open drain right outside the school gate poses a disease hazard.

description: Non-functioning streetlights, blinking lights, dark streets at night, and damaged lighting poles.
examples: Streetlights on the main avenue have been dark for over a week.
Streetlight pole is bent and light is flickering constantly.
Dark stretch of road near the bus stop feels unsafe after sunset.

description: Mosquito breeding, fogging requirements, stray animal menace, and unsanitary meat/food stalls.
examples: Severe mosquito breeding in stagnant water; municipal fogging needed.
Aggressive pack of stray dogs chasing pedestrians and two-wheelers.
Dead animal lying on the roadside needs immediate removal.

description: Traffic jams, illegal parking, noise pollution from loudspeakers, and neighborhood security concerns.
examples: Illegal commercial vehicle parking is blocking our residential gate.
Loud music being played late night past permissible hours.
Traffic light signal at the crossroad is not functioning.

description: City bus delays, missing bus stops, rash driving by public buses, and route availability.
examples: City bus on route 12 skipped our stop for three consecutive trips.
Bus shelter glass is broken and has no seating for commuters.
Buses are overcrowding severely during morning office hours.

description: Property tax payment issues, trade licenses, birth/death certificate delays, and encroachment.
examples: Birth certificate application has been pending for over 3 weeks.
Illegal commercial stall encroaching public footpath.
Online property tax portal is not generating the receipt.

description: General grievances or multi-departmental civic complaints requiring administrative review.
examples: General municipal inquiry not covered in other civic categories.
Complaint involves multiple civic agencies simultaneously.
Inquiry about local ward councilor office timings.
